question: Which of the following national park is inscribed in UNESCO's World Heritage List (Natural) as of September, 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Keoladeo National Park.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Keoladeo National Park is inscribed in UNESCO's World Heritage List (Natural) as of September 2020.**
 
• Keoladeo National Park is located in Bharatpur, Rajasthan.
 
• It is formerly known as the Bharatpur Bird Sanctuary.
 
• This site was declared the UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1985.
 
• It became a bird sanctuary in 1956 and was declared a national park in 1981.
 
• It was renamed Keoladeo for the ancient temple in the park dedicated to the Hindu god Shiva.
